source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape with ink-and-light-color mountains, misty water, clustered architecture, distant ridges, rocky shores, and sparse red foliage accents. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: central_craggy_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant central mountain formation: stacked rounded cliffs, steep gullies, terraced ledges, and dark conifer bands climbing the slopes. Exclude surrounding calligraphy, seals, sky, and the small village at the lower right edge.
must_preserve: layered ink contour lines defining rounded rock faces
dry-brush texture and pale ochre-gray washes on cliff surfaces
dark blue-black tree-dot clusters and short vertical pine strokes along ridges
soft mist gaps separating terraces and valleys
arching central ridge line and vertical cliff striations

motifs.name: left_needle_cliffs_and_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the left-side vertical rock needles and adjacent wooded cliff ledges, including the pale upright spires, dark tree bands, and small red-leaf shrubs embedded in the rocks. Avoid nearby calligraphy and red seals.
must_preserve: tall pale pillar-like cliff silhouettes
thin ink outlines and vertical texture strokes
dark clustered treetops along ledges
small red foliage accents among gray rocks
misty white breaks at the cliff bases

motifs.name: upper_right_distant_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the distant rolling ridge on the upper right: soft pale hills with a dotted dark treeline along the crest and hazy washes receding into open space.
must_preserve: faint gray contour lines of the far hills
soft diluted wash edges fading into mist
dark dotted tree strokes along the ridge crest
subtle ochre tint on the slopes
open atmospheric spacing around the ridge

motifs.name: mid_right_lakeside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the small village cluster on the mid-right shore beneath the mountain: several low buildings with layered roofs, thin walls, nearby trees, and a narrow shoreline path. Exclude the large mountain mass above as much as possible.
must_preserve: precise dark roof outlines and eave geometry
light tan roof and wall washes
thin horizontal shoreline and path lines
small vertical tree strokes behind and between buildings
tiny red-orange foliage accents near the water

motifs.name: lower_left_bridge_hamlet
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left waterfront hamlet with a covered structure, bridge-like walkway, posts, rocks, and bare trees beside the water. Keep it separate from the broad blank lake surface.
must_preserve: fine roof lines and layered eaves
bridge or walkway posts drawn with thin ink strokes
bare branch silhouettes at the left
low shoreline rocks with dry-brush texture
pale wash transitions where the structure meets mist and water

motifs.name: central_misty_lake_surface
motifs.description: Isolate the broad central lake or mist-filled water plane, including the open blank water, faint horizontal shore contours, and subtle wash boundaries between banks. Do not include buildings or major tree groups.
must_preserve: large unpainted water/mist expanse
very faint horizontal ripples and shoreline traces
soft irregular edges where banks dissolve into water
pale gray wash transitions
minimal ink marks that define depth without clutter

motifs.name: foreground_tall_tree_islet
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground rocky islet with tall slender trees, drooping foliage, red-leaf shrubs, grasses, and clustered rocks near the center-right foreground. Exclude the lower-right houses.
must_preserve: long thin trunks with varied ink pressure
drooping dark leaf clusters and needle-like foliage
red berry-like and leaf accents among shrubs
rounded foreground rocks with gray-ochre washes
fine grasses and reeds at the water edge

motifs.name: lower_right_terraced_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right architectural group set on a rocky bank: multi-level pavilions, walls, roof ridges, surrounding shrubs, and vertical cliff edge. Exclude the red seal at the bottom corner.
must_preserve: stacked roof geometry with crisp ink eaves
pale walls and light ochre roof washes
dark shrub and tree strokes framing the buildings
rock ledge texture beneath the structures
vertical architectural posts and terrace lines

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
